item.title: What Is Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response (ASMR)?
item.description: ASMR has been described as euphoric tingling and even brain orgasms. Learn more about this popular phenomenon and why some people experience it.

item.title: Yeast Infections and Sex: What You Need to Know
item.description: Having sex while treating a yeast infection can be problematic: Intercourse may interfere with medication, and condoms may be damaged by yeast infection medication. Learn more about sexual activity and yeast infections.

item.title: ‘Dawson’s Creek’ Star James Van Der Beek Dies at 48 After Colon Cancer Battle
item.description: Van Der Beek shared in 2024 that he’d been diagnosed with stage 3 colon cancer — the leading cause of cancer death among Americans under 50.

item.title: Mild Cognitive Impairment: How to Ask for Help Without Losing Your Independence
item.description: Mild cognitive impairment can threaten independence. Learn how to ask for help effectively while maintaining control. Explore strategies for communication and building your support team.

item.title: Breast Cancer Stages 0–4: What They Mean
item.description: Stages are numbers used to describe how far a cancer has advanced and where it has spread in the body. Learn how your stage affects your prognosis.

item.title: Hair Extensions, Used by Millions, Often Contain Toxic Chemicals
item.description: A new study of hair extension products found dozens of potentially hazardous substances. Is it possible to minimize your risk?

item.title: ​​What Do the New Dietary Guidelines Mean for Cancer and Cancer Risk?
item.description: A lifestyle medicine doctor shares her perspectives on the new dietary guidelines and how they affect people navigating cancer or cancer risk, emphasizing the importance of plant-based eating, limiting processed foods, and reconsidering alcohol consumption.

item.title: How to Prevent Bedbugs (and Keep Them From Coming Back)
item.description: Discover effective bedbug prevention tips for home and travel. Learn how to avoid infestations, prevent bedbugs from returning, and keep your home and items bug-free.

item.title: Testing for Asperger’s Syndrome
item.description: Asperger's symptoms are now considered part of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Testing for ASD involves screening tools to identify signs followed by professional evaluation and diagnosis.
